    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Replace the hardcoded fallback BASE_URL from "http://localhost:3000" to use a proper production URL or ensure the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is correctly set. This is because the password reset email link currently uses localhost, which does not work for users outside the local development environment.
args.title: Use a correct production base URL for password reset emails instead of localhost
